title: Smelody brings music into the perfume bottle with a patented sound device
summary: The Grasse-based start-up combines eight fragrances with classical music pieces, played automatically when the bottle is opened through a patented sound device built into the cap. This packaging innovation puts the multisensory experience at the heart of the product. What if a perfume bottle could also play music? This is the concept developed by Smelody, a young company founded in September 2025 in Grasse by Frederick Besson, also the creator of the Perfumist app. Launched in October 2026... - Innovation & new products

products.name: Lac Noir
products.launch_quote: Launched in October 2026 at an event held at La Seine Musicale, in Paris, the brand’s first collection is built around a patented innovation: a sound module integrated into the bottle cap that automatically plays a musical excerpt as soon as the bottle is opened.
